title: Benchmark Appendix: Cross-Domain Validation Summary
caveat: Detection-rate numbers are not directly comparable across rows because the label models differ. Bayesian change-point localization, curated boundary timestamps, |B|-gradient heuristics, and switchback sign criteria are different validation modes, not one shared leaderboard.

tier_1_flagship.best_metric: CP at 119.5 AU; pre=4.35, post=0.13 (33x drop)
tier_1_flagship.main_caveat: Single crossing event per spacecraft; validated by V1/V2 agreement

tier_1_flagship.best_metric: CP at 123.8 AU; pre=0.12, post=0.02 (7x drop)
tier_1_flagship.main_caveat: V1 pre-crossing associator is lower than V2 (different heliosheath conditions)

tier_2_cross_domain.main_caveat: Strongest Earth result. Single probe, single 7-day window.
Heuristic labels inflate crossing count. FPI composite upgrade available.
Bow shock is noisier than magnetopause; downstream turbulence generates extra transitions.
Lunar orbit post-2011; mixing wake crossings with magnetotail structures.
Compact magnetosphere with many substructures; MP-only list misses BS and FTE events.
Normalization-sensitive: ~40% genuine phase geometry, ~60% amplification. Direction-only ablation is the honest number.
Regime classification, not point-event detection. Possible radial trend (weaker contrast closer to Sun).
Cleanest heuristic result; induced boundaries are easier than dipolar. Curated IMB list upgrade available.
Establishes the inner-heliosphere floor. Signal is spectral-only (destroyed by phase randomization).

tier_2_cross_domain.best_metric: Fast-wind 2-4x amplification at 27-82 AU; ratio 1.01 at 1 AU
tier_2_cross_domain.main_caveat: Radial-distance-dependent effect. Fast/slow discrimination only emerges beyond ~5 AU.

tier_2_cross_domain.best_metric: Continuous radial coverage 1-50 AU in densified cube
tier_2_cross_domain.main_caveat: Part of densified pipeline; no independent boundary detection, provides radial context.
